name: Redis Cloud
line: Hosted Redis database for key-value data, vector search, and message streams.

free.text: 30MB, 100 ops/s, 5GB/mo; evaluation deletes after 14d idle; Free rule unclear

cells.metered: Essentials from USD $5/mo; Pro min USD $200/mo
cells.regions: AWS, GCP and Azure; plan coverage varies
cells.selfhost: Yes, Redis 8+ offers an AGPLv3 option

sql.math: 1 GB of data needs a 2.5 GB plan with replication (nominal size). The exact regional quote and add-ons are not available.
The kept 1 GB workload is more than Free's 30 MB. The paid regional subscription price is not available, and it stays due while idle.

files.math: Redis Cloud does not offer general file storage.

jobs.math: Both the Streams broker and outside workers are needed. Worker hosting, message size, commands and retention are not priced.
